To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a LC-MS /MS method for the simultaneous determination of 6 main compounds of Salvia miltiorrhiza in rat plasma and brains was developed and applied to the pharmacokinetic studies of the drugs.
the developed LC-MS/ MS method can be used for pharmacokinetic study in rats.
the developed method is sensitive, selective and simple enough to be applied to the pharmacokinetic and brain distribution study of the 7 components in the future.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a LC-MS method for the simultaneous determination of six Saliva miltiorrhizae gradients in rat plasma, brain, and brain homogenate, which can be applied in pharmacokinetic studies and the study of the 5 components crossing the blood-brain-barrier.
the development of a sensitive LC-MS/ MS method for the determination and quantification of the six main components in rat plasma and rat brain.
the simultaneous detection of the 6 major ingredients in the plasma and brain of rats, and the results provide a reference for the pharmacokinetic studies of Salvia miltiorrhiza.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the method is suitable for the determination of six main components in rat plasma and rat brain.

the LC-MS/ MS method is a reliable method to determine protocatechuicacid, protocatechuicaldehyde, salvianolica acid A, salvialonic acid B, cryptosanshinone and tanxsinone II(A) simultaneously in rat plasma and brainsamples.
the method is feasible for the determination of the 6 compounds in rat plasma and rat brain.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the method can be applied to pharmacokinetics studies of the 5 components in rats.
we developed a LC-MS method for the simultaneous determination of protocatechualdehyde, salvianol A and cryptotanshinones in rat plasma and brains.
the method is suitable enough to be used in the pharmacokinetics study of the 4 main components of Salvia miltorrhiza in rats.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the 6 main compounds of Salvia miltiornhiza can pass through the blood-brain barriers and enter into the brain tissue, which may have an important role in treating the diseases of central nervous system.
the 6 components can cross the blood-bra in barrier, which provides the possibility to treat brain ischemia with Salvia miltio rhiza.
the method can be used to study the pharmacokinetics of the 6 compounds, and to study their pharmacodynamics in the brain.
